mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate compresses the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the cost of capital decreases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate falls below 0.25%, it signals an aggressive monetary easing policy that boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS growth and UNRATE decline fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing boom regime defined by high new housing starts (HOUST > 650), increased construction activity and consumer confidence drive stronger corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 650, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 7.5%, it signals a tight labor market that supports wage growth and consumer spending, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 7.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, which supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is rising, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising quarterly GDP (GDPC1) indicates expanding economic activity that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 is rising, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 100, it signals robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
